title: Review the README before the 0.3.0 release
body: Check every command and flag the README names against the binary's --help, the storage and sync section against init and sync, and the screen paragraph against the TUI. Fold in foam-3909f8: add a short command reference at the end naming every command and its flags, so the README stops leaving commands out.
close_reason: README matched to --help and to init, sync, stats and the screen; command reference added
